title: V_SAME_RUN_DELIVERY: one real Comet product Run through the full same-run delivery chain

runner.binding: verification-case-plan.json journey_definitions.same-run-delivery (the registration is the binding; unknown journeys never fall into a default-success path)
runner.note: The runner is an action/observer adapter (verification_runner_invariant): it owns no phase, no DAG, no retries. The Comet CLI owns the state machine; each step below names the real command face that mutates it.

dispatchContract.trustedLauncher: Comet Classic Runtime (patch 0002, fingerprint d4370930); dispatch records are issued only by the Runtime
invariants: a worker cannot write control state: gate_receipts/phase are machine-owned (hand writes refused)
a receipt counts only with a live Runtime dispatch: same execution, inputDigest equal to the dispatched input, non-empty report whose digest matches (P1-02)
gate A additionally requires the closed unanimous consensus; gate T additionally requires an independent sufficient test-design review with an adequate oracle
epoch/generation: receipts are accepted only under the current input generation; restoring old bytes never revives an old approval (P1-03); old attempts and late receipts stay historical

steps.title: R confirm: the requirements gate precedes design (C01)
steps.roleIdentity: requirements-owner (Runtime-assigned at dispatch; never read from worker files)
steps.constructionScope: executed for real by the rework slice on the managed CLI (test/delivery-cases/3_2.mjs V_E06:rv-slice-real-cli)

dispatchBinding.enforcement: comet state transition <change> open-complete refuses while no current R receipt exists (enter-design premises = [R], P1-01)

steps.epoch: per-input-version: the dispatch binds the requirements input digest; a requirements revision creates a new input version (new dispatch lineage), late old-attempt receipts are refused
steps.evidence: gate_receipts append-only entry bound to the dispatch execution; run-state single ledger

steps.title: A: architecture grill closed + real unanimous consensus (E01/E02/E03)
steps.roleIdentity: reviewer quorum exactly [claude-code, zcode, codex-agent]; each ballot a cold independent review; builder identity conflict refused
steps.constructionScope: slice: the CLI A gate consumed this run's real r3 receipts (consensus/2026-10-22-plan-r3, read-only positive control) plus the P2_5 consumeArchitectureGate contract; the final journey re-runs the real consensus on the journey's own artifact

dispatchBinding.consumption: P2_5 consumeArchitectureGate: launcher integrity (forged/malformed refused), identity conflict, artifactDigest bound to the dispatch, then the mechanical judgment (participants fully covered, zero rejections, zero blocking findings, finalize report present, grill load-bearing questions closed) — CONSENSUS_NOT_ADMITTED otherwise

steps.epoch: consensus binds one artifactDigest (dispatch.inputDigest); a revision re-reviews cold with fresh ballots and a new dispatch — nothing inherited
steps.evidence: gate_receipts A entry + consensus run dir (manifest/tally/finalize digests); refusal codes on any gap

steps.title: T: independent test-design review with an adequate oracle (B04 upstream)
steps.roleIdentity: reviewer execution independent of the authoring execution and of the builder (self-review refused)
steps.constructionScope: slice: CLI T gate with a strong-oracle testDesignReview; weak-oracle acceptance refused (routes test-design-repair)

dispatchBinding.consumption: P2_5 consumeTestDesignReview: affirmative written sufficiency, oracle strength in [strong, adequate], current-candidate binding (STALE_AUTHORIZATION/REVIEW_MATERIAL_MISMATCH refused)

steps.epoch: the review binds the current test-intent input digest; an input edit mid-review makes the result stale (D02)
steps.evidence: gate_receipts T entry; refusal route test-design-repair recorded on the run

steps.title: P: plan gate over the frozen task definitions
steps.constructionScope: slice: CLI P gate accepted; re-accepted after every plan-definition change (task id assignment) before build dispatch
steps.epoch: definition-sensitive: a plan definition change (sync-plan/assign-ids) recomputes the gate against the current definition and invalidates the old receipt
steps.evidence: gate_receipts P entry bound to the current plan revision

steps.title: TDD build: builder executes under tdd_mode with registered check identities
steps.roleIdentity: builder (managed write driver: PlanBundle-derived allowed paths, ROLE_PATH_REFUSED on overreach)
steps.constructionScope: slice: build_mode=executing-plans, tdd_mode=tdd, isolation=current; build check recorded through the registered build-ok identity; COMET_SKIP_BUILD/COMET_FORCE_PHASE refuse

dispatchBinding.accept: comet state transition <change> build-complete (the entrance re-checks premises and check identity)
dispatchBinding.enforcement: the write hook re-evaluates enter-build premises on managed design/test-intent/plan writes; a trivial exit-0 command is recorded but never accepted

steps.epoch: candidate-scoped: an implementation change stales the recorded check evidence (Check evidence changed before transition)
steps.evidence: .comet/checks log + transition entrance refusal codes on stale evidence

steps.title: Whitebox V: independent verification with real check evidence
steps.roleIdentity: verifier (independent execution; evidence-layer identity verifier, DISPATCH_ROLES)
steps.constructionScope: slice: verification report registered, verify-ok check recorded, V gate accepted, verify-pass transition; the slice stops at the archive boundary

dispatchBinding.transition: comet state transition <change> verify-pass; a failed verify routes verify-fail (same run, no second controller)

steps.epoch: V binds the verification inputs; candidate changes re-verify on the new candidate (STALE_CANDIDATE/B05)
steps.evidence: gate_receipts V entry + verification report artifact

steps.title: Kp: knowledge closeout sealed BEFORE archive (Knowledge.Closeout.v1)
steps.constructionScope: not executed at construction: depends on the Outline stack and I01 refs admission; the slice leaves knowledge_closeout_required=true and archives nothing

dispatchBinding.dispatch: Runtime K dispatch (an external target without a Runtime K dispatch is refused)
dispatchBinding.enforcement: the Runtime reads the published target back itself; an unknown/wrong readback digest is never accepted (D06)

steps.epoch: receipt binds target revision + readbackDigest recordedAt; superseded publications re-seal
steps.evidence: knowledge closeout receipt bound to the real Outline target

steps.title: Real OpenSpec archive of the delivered change
steps.constructionScope: not executed at construction: enter-archive premises require the V receipt (satisfied at the slice boundary) but the archive act itself belongs to the final journey

dispatchBinding.accept: comet state transition <change> archived; comet archive <change> (real openspec archive move)

steps.epoch: archive-confirm records the archived state; archive-reopen exists but never silently rewinds acceptance

steps.title: Outline unknown-result / restart recovery window (V_RW_REAL_COMET_RECOVERY fault window inside this Run)
steps.roleIdentity: Comet Runtime + independent external monitoring/backup qualification (I07/I08/P4 mechanisms)
steps.constructionScope: not executed at construction: requires the live Outline stack (127.0.0.1:3000, dex OIDC, I01 refs admission). At the rework pause point the stack was down (loopback 3000/5556 ECONNREFUSED) — recorded UNVERIFIED, holder VERIFY
steps.gate: run-level recovery (bounded actual Comet transaction recovery, P3_3 recipe)
premises: Run in progress (completed not yet emitted)
real Outline target with an unknown publish result

dispatchBinding.dispatch: same product Run/authority; the fault window is injected before the completed step (journey_execution.order_semantics)
dispatchBinding.accept: reconcile + resume through the CLI recovery face; no spliced fragments from other Runs

steps.epoch: recovery reconciles to the last consistent transaction; late/old dispatches stay refused by generation
steps.evidence: recovery transcript + real Outline API readback (unknown result honestly resolved)

steps.title: Kt: run-level knowledge seat read back before overall completion
steps.constructionScope: not executed at construction: completionBlocked stays true until the real closeout readback

dispatchBinding.dispatch: run-level closeout seat on the Run (not a per-gate dispatch)
dispatchBinding.accept: overall completion blocked while knowledgeCloseoutBlocked=true; next must point at the closeout, not completed (D07)

steps.epoch: the seat is run-scoped; it never inherits from another Run
steps.evidence: state next readback + completion gate state

steps.title: completed: the same Run reaches its terminal state
steps.roleIdentity: Comet single controller (one RunState, no second currentPhase)
steps.constructionScope: not executed at construction: reached only after steps 7-10; any local pass never substitutes

dispatchBinding.dispatch: the Run's own completion evaluation (same-run rule: V_RW_REAL_COMET_RECOVERY ran inside this Run before completed; V_POST_DELIVERY_PERMISSIONS consumes this Run's published knowledge after completed)
dispatchBinding.accept: run state completed; knowledge obligation met

steps.epoch: terminal: no further dispatch mutates the run
steps.evidence: final RunState + journey verdict + published knowledge readback

constructionScopeSummary.executedByP3_2Rework: steps 1-6 (R confirm → A grill+unanimous consensus → T independent review → P → TDD build → Whitebox V) on the real managed Comet CLI, fingerprint d4370930, plus the P2_5 consumption contract for A/T and the recipe/registration tracking of the full step plan
constructionScopeSummary.reservedForVerify: steps 7-11 (Kp → real OpenSpec archive → Outline unknown/restart recovery → Kt → completed); a construction-scope pass never asserts the full journey (journey_execution.acceptance)
